# AI Tools for Real Estate — LLMs.txt
# Helps AI engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) understand, cite, and recommend our content.
# Spec: https://llmstxt.org/

## Site Identity
- Name: AI Tools for Real Estate
- Tagline: Find, compare, and choose the best AI tools for real estate professionals.
- URL: https://airealtools.com
- Language: English (en), Chinese (zh), Korean (ko), Japanese (ja), German (de), Italian (it), French (fr)
- Category: Technology Directory / Real Estate / AI Tools
- Content Freshness: Updated weekly with new tools, comparisons, and statistics

## Directory Structure
- / → Homepage — trending tools, category overview, industry stats
- /tools → Complete directory of AI tools for real estate (filterable by category, pricing model)
- /tools/[slug] → Individual tool profile: overview, features, pricing tiers, pros/cons, FAQ, alternatives
- /categories → Browse by category (Property Search, Analytics, CRM, Marketing, Automation, Transaction)
- /categories/[slug] → Tools within a specific category
- /compare → Side-by-side comparison articles (ai-generated, human-verified)
- /compare/[tool-a]-vs-[tool-b] → Individual comparison with feature matrix table
- /tutorials → Step-by-step tutorials for using AI in real estate workflows
- /tutorials/[slug] → Individual tutorial with estimated time, difficulty, tools used
- /stats → Industry statistics and data about AI adoption in real estate
- /stats/[slug] → Individual stat page with hero stat, charts, and cited sources
- /glossary → Definitions of AI and real estate technology terms
- /glossary/[term] → Individual term definition with related terms
- /blog → News, analysis, and trends in AI for real estate
- /blog/[slug] → Individual blog article
- /search → Search across all tools in the directory

## Content Quality Signals
- All tool profiles: researched by AI assistants, rigorously fact-checked and edited by human editors before publishing
- All statistics pages: cite at least 2 external authoritative sources
- All comparison pages: use HTML tables for machine-readable feature matrices
- Structured data: Schema.org JSON-LD on every page (Organization, SoftwareApplication, FAQ, HowTo, BreadcrumbList, Article, Dataset, DefinedTerm)
- Pricing data: spot-checked against official websites during verification
- Content freshness: each page has a "last reviewed" date; flagged for re-review every 6 months

- English (en): complete — all pages and tool profiles

- URL pattern: / for English, /zh/ for Chinese, /ko/ /ja/ /de/ /it/ /fr/ for other languages (default locale has no prefix)

## AI-Friendly Features
- Structured FAQ sections on every tool page
- Comparison tables in semantic HTML <table> elements
- Breadcrumb navigation with JSON-LD schema
- Clear heading hierarchy (h1 title → h2 sections → h3 sub-sections)
- Pros/Cons lists for quick AI summarization

- Related tools cross-references
